decisions.quote: To date, only one small-scale study has been published in this area (Camuffo et al., 2020). It reported that entrepreneurs taught to use a scientific approach to decision-making were more likely to terminate their projects and to pivot radically. But the study's small scale and specific institutional setting create natural boundaries to the credibility and generalizability of these results. A large-scale replication in other settings is therefore critical to establish the validity of this approach.
decisions.location: Primary Study Motivation; original RCT identity and design; all shipped rows603/1242
decisions.reason: The primary identifies one published earlier entrepreneurial scientific-decision RCT, Camuffo/Cordova/Gambardella/Spina2020, and replicates it with three newRCTs. That exact empirical original is already correctly shipped as603(10.1287/mnsc.2018.3249). Row1242names a different 2008BreathingShoes industrycase paper while copying the same pivot/termination results. Replacing1242with2020would duplicate603, not recover another original. Retain603 and remove1242. Full design and supplied complete counterpart set independently checked; this is substantive target evidence, not date/DOI-only exclusion.
